narrative: The Dev Box puts a capable local-inference target straight in the coding-agent path, lending the premise that locally-served models rival cloud-only APIs for everyday development. But it cuts against the consumer-GPU framing: this is a datacenter-class, first-party, pre-release deskside part sold only through Microsoft.com, shipping an IDE and runtime rather than a local-first harness default, with no developer-share signal.
remaining_gap: A consumer-grade GPU running a coding-agent harness with a local-first default, plus a measurable developer-share or displacement metric near the 30% threshold.
